scientific_question: Can the three-parameter Chwirut exponential model trained at lower metal distances predict the preregistered highest-distance holdout?

data.name: NIST/ITL StRD Chwirut2
data.reference: Chwirut, D., NIST (1979), Ultrasonic Reference Block Study
data.units_as_published: y is ultrasonic response; x is metal distance; no additional unit conversion or uncertainty is invented

model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit with identical settings and two starts; select the lowest training residual sum of squares

holdout_rule.definition: All observations with metal distance x >= 5.0 are held out; every repeated x value stays entirely on one side of the split
holdout_rule.purpose: Contiguous high-distance extrapolation, not random interpolation and not a universal test of the model family

full_fit_certification_rule.purpose: A separate known-answer reproduction check against NIST, never used as holdout evidence

baselines: Ordinary least-squares linear response fitted only on the training interval
metrics: Training and holdout RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual
Holdout RMSE divided by training RMSE
Holdout RMSE compared with both baselines
Parameter values from each start and optimizer success

decision_gate.limited_support: Holdout RMSE < 3 * training RMSE AND holdout RMSE < linear-baseline holdout RMSE
decision_gate.negative_or_unresolved: Otherwise report the model class as not supported for this extrapolation task; do not retune on the holdout
decision_gate.interpretation: Passing is limited evidence for this single split only, not a universal law, physical discovery, clinical implication or proof of parameter endogeneity

output_rule: Write validation/chwirut-holdout.json and papers/04_真实数据留出/fig04_chwirut_holdout.png; preserve all starts and negative results; refuse to overwrite existing results
prohibitions: No fitting or parameter selection on the seven holdout observations
No cherry-picking a different holdout after seeing residuals
No claim that NIST certification is independent experimental replication by us
No claim that fitting proves the model is universally valid or all parameters are physically endogenous
